scope: Exploratory B1 only, six paired timed cohorts, 77 unique six-choice BANKING77 training-source development cases; exposure unknown. Warmup excluded from shape/tail statistics.
schema: All 77 cases retain every six-pair body and row-residence observation, including regressions. No new promotion threshold or protocol change.
limits: Canonical body intervals include per-batch row bookkeeping; row residence measures the model call plus synchronization and differs from body timing.
The repeated-row p95 uses 462 correlated observations per arm, not 462 independent requests or six cohort p95 values. Both metrics are retained; neither overrides the frozen gates.
Token length, case order, menu content and preceding telemetry pacing are confounded; exact length groups and correlations are exploratory, not causal or inferential tests.
Prebatch utilization is a sampled utilization snapshot, not GPU clock, power, thermal state or within-call kernel attribution. Governor variation is possible but unobserved.
No profiler, frameworks, model, GPU or network execution occurred. Prior representative dispatch evidence does not trace these timed calls.
No B8 data admitted and no new threshold, selection, speed claim or production promotion introduced.
next_smallest_hypothesis: If tail observations cluster by length or execution order, a separately declared representative long/short B1 profile with synchronized host/device boundaries and explicit clock/power observations could distinguish launch/host overhead from attention work. CUDA graph capture remains a separate bounded hypothesis requiring fixed-shape buffers, variable-length admission and parity tests; this analysis does not establish its benefit.
